messages:
incident-bot: Pager: metering anomaly — sudden token-count delta detected in us-west-2 ingestion pipeline (metric: metering.tokens.count vs model.input_tokens). Alert threshold crossed at 1870012320. Link: https://ops.redwood/internal/alerts/1870012345 :rotating_light:

ashley: acked. I'm on-call (ashley). Looking into metering pipeline. @billing-ops-bot please standby for potential overage suppression.

devon: I'm pulling logs from meter-aggregator (deployed ~2026-03-14 04:12 UTC). Seeing repeated event_ids for same request across retries — looks like dedup layer isn't matching new header format.

mike: are customers already seeing overage flags? any automated billing triggers fired?

billing-ops-bot: A bunch of overage flags were created between 1870012300-1870012400. We're holding on automated invoicing but alerts were sent. I'll mute customer overage emails once ops gives go.

ashley: mitigation plan: 1) Pause outgoing overage emails 2) Flip meter_dedup_v2 feature flag off (rollback of dedup behavior) 3) Start live recon job to recompute counted tokens for window 1870012000-1870013200 4) Post customer comms draft.

devon: quick check (logs):
```
grep "event_id" /var/log/meter-aggregator/2026-03-14.log | head -n 5
2026-03-14T04:15:23Z event_id=cbf1a2 req_id=xyz user=acct_123 tokens=2048
2026-03-14T04:15:23Z event_id=cbf1a2 req_id=xyz-retry user=acct_123 tokens=2048
2026-03-14T04:15:24Z event_id=d8b3f0 req_id=abc user=acct_456 tokens=512
2026-03-14T04:15:24Z event_id=d8b3f0 req_id=abc-retry user=acct_456 tokens=512
```
Looks like retries are appending "-retry" to req_id and the deduper keyed only on req_id, not event_id. New runtime changed headers so aggregator didn't receive X-Event-Id consistently.

ashley: can we flip the feature flag now? devon, can you confirm the toggle name and the command?

devon: flag is `meter_dedup_v2` on consul kv path `feature-flags/meter_dedup_v2`. Flip via:
```
consul kv put feature-flags/meter_dedup_v2 false
kubectl rollout restart deployment/meter-aggregator -n infra
```
I'll run both. Expect 30-90s to stabilize.

sre-rotations: I'm watching the rollout and tailing aggregator logs. If we see error spikes we rollback. Created INC-2026-234 in tracker.

billing-ops-bot: muting outgoing overage emails for the next 2 hours. Applied suppression rule ID sup-187001. Will coordinate credits after recon.

devon: rolled flag to false and restarted aggregator. Logs show dedup working now — sample after toggle: 
```
2026-03-14T04:18:05Z event_id=cbf1a2 req_id=xyz user=acct_123 tokens=2048 dedup_status=duplicate_dropped
```
reductions visible in metrics in ~45s.

mike: good. what's the scope of the miscount? any estimate of customers affected / percent overcount?

devon: early sample: of 12k requests in window, ~18% double-counted due to retry naming change. Heaviest impact on streaming requests with transient 503s.

ashley: starting live recon to reprocess raw events and recompute token totals for impacted window. Command: `./tools/recompute_metering --from 1870012000 --to 1870013200 --parallel 8 --dry-run=false`

nina: I'll draft the customer note. Proposed: short apology, impact summary (some customers saw inflated usage counts between 04:12-04:22 UTC), we will recompute usage and apply automatic credits where needed. Assigning to billing to confirm timeline.

billing-ops-bot: confirmed. We can apply provisional credits within 24 hours after recon completes. We'll also suppress any auto-collection for accounts with >10% deviation.

devon: recon job started at 1870012600 (PID 4521). Monitoring progress: 
```
./tools/recompute_metering --status 4521
Processed 100k events (12% corrected) 
ETA ~18m
```

sre-rotations: created short-lived dashboard: https://dash.redwood/internal/query?panel=meter-recon-187001 showing live before/after counts per account. Sharing with billing and support.

mike: finance FYI — this will impact revenue for the window. We should capture expected credits in accounting so end-of-day reports don't skew.

billing-ops-bot: noted. Posting expected credits once recon finishes. We'll also queue a reconciliation job to backfill invoices.

ashley: status update: recon finished at 1870013420. Final numbers: 1.2M tokens overcounted across 280 accounts. Average correction ~14% for impacted accounts. Recon job output (truncated):
```
Recompute complete: scanned 1.1M raw events, corrected 158k duplicated token events, net correction -1,204,512 tokens.
Affected accounts: 280
Top affected account: acct_987 delta -120,480 tokens (3.2% of monthly usage)
```

billing-ops-bot: applying credits now. We will send customer email tonight with explanation and credit summary. Marking auto-overage suppression lifted at 1870013600.

nina: customer email queued. Draft shared in #customer-comms for legal review.

devon: root cause: aggregator dedup logic relied on `X-Request-Id` header which changed format in runtime v2 to include suffixes for retries. Fix: update deduper to key on `X-Event-Id` and add defensive parsing for `-retry` suffix. Patch proposed in PR #5425.

ashley: postmortem owners: devon (root cause/fix), billing-ops (customer impact & credits), nina (customer comms), ashley (incident lead). Aim for action items and timeline in postmortem doc by EOD tomorrow.

sre-rotations: closing pager. Marking incident as mitigated. Follow-up ticket: PM-187001-recon-postmortem.
